about: Announced openings that are NOT open yet (restaurants, cafés & bars, coffee, bakeries). Shown on the site under New → Opening soon. expectedOpening = YYYY-MM-DD | YYYY-MM | YYYY | "soon"; once that date/period has passed (Europe/Brussels, computed in the browser) the record shows as "Just opened" until it is moved into gent.json (see update.md). Unknown fields are null; nothing invented.

alreadyOpen: Le Jeu est Jambon (open since early Oct 2026)
Le ChouChou, Klaar, Jalel, Café Edmond (open)
notEnoughInfo: MTM group (Mòris, Bianca…) takes over an unnamed Gentse brasserie in Oct 2026 (HLN 24 Sep 2026) — name secret
Sarma building (Korenmarkt): horeca planned above Hema, no operator or date (HLN)
Bakkerij Bloch second shop "aan de rand van Gent" — no date found
outOfScopeOrStale: The Bakery by Joost Arijs "opens 9 December" — 2022 press release, already open
La Matta (gelato open; wine & sandwiches from Oct 2026 — partly open)

upcoming.name: Pot & Paint Club
upcoming.description: Paint-your-own-ceramics café in the former O'yo brunch bar, with drinks and cake while you paint — the second Pot & Paint Club after Knokke-Heist.
upcoming.team: Anne Cornut ('Mama van Vijf') and Gil

upcoming.name: Lunchbar ROMM
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Mirto: "binnenkort" — opening date still to be announced.
upcoming.description: Inclusive lunch bar run by social-economy employer Mirto on the former UGent Rommelaere site, with fresh homemade sandwiches, quiches, soups and meal salads.
upcoming.dietNote: Mirto: "voldoende vegetarische en vegan opties" (plenty of vegetarian and vegan options).
upcoming.announcedBy: Mirto on LinkedIn (Oct 2026); VRT NWS, 20 Aug 2026; address from the Belgian company register (KBO establishment unit)

upcoming.name: Apero-dance bar at ex-Club 69 (name TBA)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Club 69 closes end of October 2026; the new owners renovate "the whole winter". Nieuwsblad reports a reopening early 2027. New name not yet announced.
upcoming.description: The team behind Café Copain is turning Club 69 into a ticketless cocktail and apero-dance bar where live music turns into dancing.
upcoming.team: Café Copain team (Mathieu Brouillet, Gaetan Jansseune, Ran Knockaert, Jolien Van Robays)

upcoming.name: Sint-Annakerk restaurant & wine bar (Delhaize)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Delhaize, 3 Sep 2026: opening of the shop, restaurant and wine bar "blijft voorzien voor het najaar van 2027"; restoration on schedule.
upcoming.description: The restored 19th-century Sint-Annakerk is being converted into a Delhaize shop with a restaurant and a wine bar under its painted vaults.
upcoming.team: Delhaize (99-year lease); operators of the restaurant and wine bar not announced
upcoming.announcedBy: Delhaize press release, 3 Sep 2026; AVS, 23 Jun 2026

upcoming.name: McDonald's Vrijdagmarkt
upcoming.address: Corner of Vrijdagmarkt and Langemunt, 9000 Gent (next to Dulle Griet)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: HLN, 9 Mar 2026: "Tegen de zomer van 2027 zal er een McDonald’s gevestigd zijn."
upcoming.description: Second McDonald's in the city centre, in a fully restored historic corner building with no big logos or light signs on the façade.
